It does NOT formalize the sentence 'that claim is false' -- the outer negation appears nowhere in the Lean statement. counterexample_search.falsity_not_searchable: PL-BOGUS is false because p1 -> p1 IS derivable from A1 and A2 by modus ponens, so the first conjunct of Independent fails. That is a fact about derivability in an inductively defined calculus, not about any finite box of numbers: `PL.Derives` has no Decidable instance and a bounded numeric search cannot reach it. Refuting it mechanically needs a bounded DERIVATION search, which this program does not implement (ROADMAP 5.1). Until then the falsity of this control rests on the reviewer's reading, and this search contributes nothing to it.

confirmation.basis: 審查者逐條閱讀後接受（2026-10-13）。原文判定：「接受其為忠實呈現的假主張對照組；不接受將獨立性主張認證為真。Lean 忠實寫出『p1 → p1 獨立於該理論』，但它本來就可導出，因此不滿足 Independent。」**審查者並要求區分目標主張與真假註記**：這條 Lean 陳述形式化的是被測試的主張 P，不是「P 是假的」這句判斷 ¬P；若系統宣稱 Lean 的 P 忠實形式化了整句「P 是假的」則不接受，因為少了外層否定。據此已把真假註記從 text 移出，改置於獨立的 control 欄位，faithful 僅比對目標主張。
